user.title: Sign in to Skylight
user.description: Enter the email and password you use in the Skylight app. Home Assistant uses them once to sign in and link your account; your password isn't stored.

browser.title: Sign in to Skylight in your browser
browser.description:
Signing in directly didn't work, so sign in on Skylight's own page instead.

1. [Open Skylight sign-in]({auth_url}) in a new tab.
2. Sign in with your Skylight email and password.
3. When the page finishes loading, look at your browser's address bar. It will contain `?code=…`.
4. Copy the value of `code` (or the whole address; either works) and paste it below within about 30 seconds.

pick_frame.title: Choose your Skylight frame
pick_frame.description: Your Skylight account has more than one frame. Pick which one to set up now — you can add the others later.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong email or password. Check them in the Skylight app and try again.
error.code_rejected: That code was rejected. Codes expire in about 30 seconds, so open the sign-in link again for a fresh one.
error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a Skylight authorization code. Paste the value of `code=` from the address bar (or the whole URL).
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Skylight. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.no_frames: No Skylight frames were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Skylight frame is already configured.
abort.all_frames_configured: Every frame on this account is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: Skylight polling intervals
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks Skylight for each kind of data, in seconds. Lower values update sooner and make more API requests. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.calendar_scan_interval: How often to refresh calendar events and connected calendars.
data_description.lists_scan_interval: How often to refresh shopping and to-do lists.
data_description.sensor_scan_interval: How often to refresh chores, meal plans, star totals and the task box.
data_description.frame_scan_interval: How often to refresh brightness, sleep schedule and other device settings.
data_description.photos_scan_interval: How often to check for a new frame photo.

upload_media.name: Upload media
upload_media.description: Upload a photo or short video to a Skylight frame.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Absolute path to the media file. Must be readable by Home Assistant.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption shown alongside the photo on the frame.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Only required with multiple frames configured.

create_chore.name: Create chore
create_chore.description: Add a chore to the frame's chore chart, assigned to one or more family members. Skylight creates a separate chore per assignee.

assignees.name: Assignees
assignees.description: Family member names, one or several — matched case-insensitively against the frame's profiles. Either this or Family member IDs is required.

category_ids.name: Family member IDs
category_ids.description: Category IDs to assign, as an alternative to Assignees. Read them off the assignee_id of an existing chore in sensor.<frame>_chores_today.

start.name: Date
start.description: Day the chore is due. Defaults to today.

start_time.name: Time
start_time.description: Optional time of day, as HH:MM:SS.

description.name: Description
description.description: Longer detail shown with the chore on the frame.

routine.name: Routine
routine.description: Mark the chore as part of a routine.

up_for_grabs.name: Up for grabs
up_for_grabs.description: Let any family member claim the chore rather than fixing it to the assignee.

recurrence_set.name: Recurrence rule
recurrence_set.description: Skylight recurrence definition. Copy the value from an existing recurring chore rather than writing one by hand.

recurring_until.name: Repeat until
recurring_until.description: Last day a recurring chore should be generated for.

renewal_interval.name: Repeat after completion
renewal_interval.description: Positive interval measured from completion. Supply Renewal unit too. Do not combine with Recurrence rule or Recurring until.

renewal_unit.name: Renewal unit
renewal_unit.description: Unit for Repeat after completion; supply both fields together.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

update_chore.name: Update chore reward and emoji
update_chore.description: Change the supplied metadata on an existing chore series, including all recurring occurrences. Does not complete the chore or award stars.

chore_id.name: Chore series ID
chore_id.description: Bare numeric series ID, without an occurrence date suffix.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.description: Optional emoji; omit to preserve the existing icon.

reward_points.name: Reward points
reward_points.description: Optional star reward. Zero removes the reward; omit to preserve it.

complete_chore.name: Complete chore for a family member
complete_chore.description: Complete a pending chore, including an up-for-grabs chore, and credit its stars to one selected family member. Requires control of the selected frame. The selected name is a credit recipient, not an authentication identity.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: Exact ID from a chores sensor. Preserve the date suffix for a recurring occurrence. Do not add a date to a bare ID.

assignee.name: Family member name
assignee.description: Exact name, case-insensitive. Supply this or Family member ID, not both.

category_id.name: Family member ID
category_id.description: Existing linked family member on this frame; alternative to a name.

completed_on.name: Completion date
completed_on.description: Actual completion date, defaulting to today in Home Assistant's time zone.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Add an unscheduled item to the frame's Task Box. The frame assigns it to a day later.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.description: Emoji shown next to the task on the frame.

reward_points.name: Reward points
reward_points.description: Points credited when the task is completed.

routine.name: Routine
routine.description: Mark the task as part of a routine.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

create_list.name: Create list
create_list.description: Create a new shopping or to-do list on the frame.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Whether this is a shopping list or a to-do list.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Colour name used on the frame.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

delete_list.name: Delete list
delete_list.description: Permanently delete a list and its items from the frame. The list ID is the trailing segment of the matching todo entity's unique ID.

list_id.name: List ID
list_id.description: ID of the list to delete.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

delete_chore.name: Delete chore
delete_chore.description: Permanently delete a chore, including every occurrence of a recurring chore. The only way to remove an up-for-grabs chore, which has no family member's to-do list to remove it from.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: ID from a chores sensor. An occurrence ID such as 12345-2026-11-04 deletes its whole series.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

create_reward.name: Create reward
create_reward.description: Add a reward that family members can redeem with earned points.

point_value.name: Point cost
point_value.description: Points needed to redeem the reward.

description.name: Description
description.description: Longer explanation shown on the frame.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.description: Emoji shown next to the reward.

category_ids.name: Family member IDs
category_ids.description: Restrict the reward to these category IDs. Omit to offer it to everyone.

respawn_on_redemption.name: Stays available
respawn_on_redemption.description: Keep the reward on the board after it's claimed.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

redeem_reward.name: Redeem reward
redeem_reward.description: Spend a family member's points on a reward.

reward_id.name: Reward ID
reward_id.description: ID of the reward to redeem.

category_id.name: Family member ID
category_id.description: Category ID of the member spending the points.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

create_recipe.name: Create recipe
create_recipe.description: Add a recipe to the frame's meal planner.

meal_category_id.name: Meal slot ID
meal_category_id.description: Meal category ID (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack) this recipe belongs to.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

plan_meal.name: Plan meal
plan_meal.description: Schedule a meal into a slot on a given day.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to schedule the meal on.

meal_category_id.name: Meal slot ID
meal_category_id.description: Meal category ID for the slot to fill.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: Recipe to schedule. Omit to block the slot out without picking a recipe.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.

add_recipe_to_grocery_list.name: Add recipe to grocery list
add_recipe_to_grocery_list.description: Push a recipe's ingredients onto the frame's default grocery list.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe whose ingredients should be added.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Target frame ID. Only required when multiple Skylight frames are configured. When omitted, the single configured frame is used.
